title: Images & Dockerfiles
summary: How images are named, addressed and distributed (tags, digests, Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR), every Dockerfile instruction that matters, CMD vs ENTRYPOINT, ARG vs ENV, the build context and cache — and a first Dockerfile for shipit-api.
objectives: Break an image reference into registry, repository, tag and digest, and explain why digests are immutable
Log in, pull, tag and push images to Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR or a local registry
Write Dockerfiles using FROM, RUN, COPY, ADD, WORKDIR, ENV, ARG, USER, EXPOSE, CMD, ENTRYPOINT and LABEL correctly
Choose between shell and exec form and between CMD and ENTRYPOINT
Order instructions for maximum cache reuse in Node.js projects and keep the build context small with .dockerignore
Inspect images with docker history, docker image inspect and dive, and bootstrap files with docker init
